connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Endpoint URL*Provide the Zentao instance API endpoint (Opensource v16+). E.g. http://<host>:<port>/api.php/v1 or http://<host>:<port>/zentao/api.php/v1Username*Password*Database URLProvide the DB URL of Zentao if you want to collect issue changelogs.ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access ZenTao directly.Custom Rate LimitBy default, DevLake uses 10,000 requests/hour for data collection for ZenTao.
